mark.suggest: Mark answers your questions and says what he'd put on your list. He adds nothing himself.
mark.act_with_approval: Mark lines the work up, and anything that would reach a customer waits on your approvals list.
mark.autonomous: Mark adds the tasks and hands work to whoever it belongs to. What each of them may then send is their own setting.

tim.suggest: Tim tells you what he found and leaves the decision to you.
tim.act_with_approval: Tim's reports wait for your approval before anyone else sees them.
tim.autonomous: Tim reports what he finds as he finds it, without asking first.

emily.suggest: Emily tells you what she'd post and write. Nothing goes out.
emily.act_with_approval: Emily writes the posts and they wait on your approvals list until you say yes.
emily.autonomous: Emily posts and sends herself. Everything she does shows in the list below.

alex.suggest: Alex tells you who to chase and what the reminder would say. He sends nothing.
alex.act_with_approval: Alex writes the reminder and it waits on your approvals list until you say yes.
alex.autonomous: Alex emails the reminder himself, and it shows in the list below with what it said.

sarah.suggest: Sarah tells you who to text and what she'd say. Nothing is sent.
sarah.act_with_approval: Sarah drafts the text and it waits on your approvals list until you say yes.
sarah.autonomous: Sarah sends the text herself, and it shows in the list below with what it said.

emma.act_with_approval: Emma still answers every call — she can't put a caller on hold. This is about her texts: she drafts the reply and it waits for your approval.
emma.autonomous: Emma answers and replies herself, day and night. Everything she does shows in the list below.

noDial.mark: There is no setting for Mark yet — nothing he does on his own reaches anyone outside the business.
noDial.tim: There is no setting for Tim: he only ever reports, so there is nothing to hold back.
noDial.emily: Emily doesn't act on her own yet — you write her campaigns with her on the Marketing and Social pages.
noDial.alex: There is no setting for Alex yet — he has nothing he can do on his own.
noDial.sarah: There is no setting for Sarah yet — she has nothing she can do on her own.
noDial.emma: There is no setting for Emma yet — she has nothing she can do on her own.

job.mark: Mark is the one you talk to. He answers questions about the business from your live numbers, adds tasks and hands work to whoever it belongs to.
job.tim: Tim reads your numbers and tells you what changed — revenue, jobs won and lost, and where the money is stuck.
job.emily: Emily plans and writes your marketing — the posts, the campaigns and the words that go with them.
job.alex: Alex watches what you're owed — who is overdue, by how much, and the reminder that gets the invoice paid.
job.sarah: Sarah works your new leads — she finds the right contact, texts them and gets the meeting into the calendar.
job.emma: Emma answers your calls around the clock, books appointments and takes a message when she can't.

limits.mark: Mark adds and assigns tasks and passes work to the rest of the team. He never texts or emails a customer himself.
limits.tim: Tim only ever reads. He writes nothing, sends nothing and spends nothing.
limits.emily: Emily drafts and schedules your marketing. She never texts or emails a client one by one.
limits.alex: Alex can email a payment reminder about an invoice this business issued. He never moves money and he never texts.
limits.sarah: Sarah can text a client who hasn't opted out of messages. She never sends invoices and never spends money.
limits.emma: Emma answers calls and texts and books, moves or cancels appointments. She never sends invoices and never spends money.
